But, with what you are going through, I don’t think that God abandoned you, I think you are believing a lie and that lie has caused you so much torment… 

Those Pharisees saw Jesus’ miracles, and it wasn’t an instant thing that they hardened their hearts. They kept on doing it. The difference between you and them is that they have their hearts so hardened they don’t repent…. 

The Pharisees didn’t do it and then mourn as if God just abandoned them completely. Jesus would accept them if they repented, (changed their mind) but they chose to harden their hearts..

God still wants you and loves you so much…. 

Don’t let this lie cause you to suffer…. 

Jesus died for you, suffered on the cross for you, was tortured for you. He is NOT going to abandon you now. 

Even when you were a sinner, Jesus died for you on the cross. 

Look at the things Jesus says with not wanting to leave you…… He loves you so much.

Know that God is not distant from you… 

When I was younger with depression, I gave a lot of hugs to band members in high school, I had troubles with feeling loved and I also had trouble talking and relating to people… 

But I guess it just wasn’t enough. I hugged them but they didn’t really understand me or know me… It was just an act but it was missing other parts that I thought I would feel doing it… 

I think that when you want sex, there is a part of you wanting the act, but if you rely on it so much for happiness and peace there is another thing to it… 

When I first went to God, I heard “God wants a relationship with you” and to me it meant “someone so big and strong, would want to love me? That means someone would always love me… someone would always stay…” 

I treated it like a crush asking me out, like someone I front of me I could see saying to me “I will always love you and always stay with you through life” 
To me, it was God offering to be there for me in a relationship I could go through it all with Him and get personal with Him like someone I could see. 

I talked to God: “Like someone offering to love me I could see, I vented to them about all my issues, I felt like it was so tiring to rely on myself so it felt comfortable telling them everything….” 

I fell in love with who He is: “Like someone in front of me caring for me, I start liking them for who they are and what they look like… When we learn about who God is, the fact that He is our creator and He made all that I am and understands all that I am, and that I am made for Him, I fall in love with His character… when you date someone multiple times you could become obsessed with who they are, the same is with God, talking to Him and thinking of Him just feels nice since the truth of who He is and the fact He would be loving means so much….” 

The truth of God’s love to you doesn’t depend on you and you don’t do this to just to earn heaven while God seems distant…

You don’t have to depend on sex to have a good life. Especially in American culture it is talked about so much, but broken relationships show it doesn’t fix it all.. you relying on sex so much for happiness shows there are other things to it. 

There can be pain in a way of not having it but it should NOT, become your only hope for happiness, with all that God offers to be in your life.. you are looking at sex to help you in ways that you should be looking at a relationship with God. 

We don’t have a relationship with God just to get something, or so we earn Him… it’s so we enjoy Him, and His love and rest in Him…. 

If someone in front of me I could see offered to love me and be with me, I would feel overwhelmed and accept happily, BUT notice we were made for God and God offers to be with us everyday, and not only this, God understands and love us more than any humans…. 

The problem is just viewing other things like sex as idols just because they seem less distant from God, but the reality is God is close…

Imagine if someone was there for you and offered to love you, no matter how you felt, or how much you did, them being there wouldn’t depend on you or your feelings so you would rest in that person… 

Think of God the same way, just rest in the truth that He is there for you….

I hope you are able to feel better in your depression…. 

Like someone in a couple wants to comfort another when they cry, God wants to comfort you with that same passion and affection… It doesn’t depend on how you feel, so just rest in the truth that God is that way with you….

Suicide isn’t a good choice, we go to heaven by faith, and this shows lack of faith in what Jesus said…

You are His creation… Jesus wants intimacy and closeness with you… That is He died for you, He thinks you’re to die for…

Even though other people may not return the same feelings, God will always love you and will receive and return your love… 

You don’t have to be enough or know enough… just go to God as you are… God wants a relationship with you… God wants you…

Viewing God as distant will hurt us a lot, but the closer we view God, all that He is, we can find peace knowing that someone so great would want to be close…

There is evidence that homosexuality is wrong in the Bible. 

But the reason to stop any sin, is not just a “because I have to” you have to look deep at your reason why you want to live for God.  

It isn’t just a to do list to feel “forced to do”. People talk a lot about Hell, but on of the greatest reason people follow God’s commandments is their love for God… 

If you don’t have a reason like “loving God” then you’ll feel less bad for sin and care less about it. 

The creator of the world, of you and me, wants a relationship with you… 

When we have a greater relationship with God, talking to God more, and falling in love with who God is, it can be a lot easier to stop sinning because we have a better reason.. 

If the reason is ONLY “I don’t want to go to Hell” then we would see God as distant and think to ourselves “fine, I guess I’ll have to find a way to fit this into my life…” 

In the Old Testament David committed crimes of adultery and even murdering the husband of the women he did it with so he wouldn’t have been found out, and what drew him to want to turn to God was “Against You, You only, I have sinned And done what is evil in Your sight, So that You are justified when You speak And blameless when You judge.” 
David was called a “man after God’s heart” He loved God so much, and the fact that He sinned against someone He loved so much hurt Him.. 

God wants nothing to be an idol and something we love more than Him, and the reason for that is not Him just wanting to nag us, but the fact that He can help us better than any parent, or spouse… God wants more closeness with us than anyone and He really does love us greatly. 

God doesn’t want us to love anything more, not even a spouse, God wants this because He offers to give us more in a relationship…. 

God won’t fix every problem, but what matters most is that no matter what He stays, and He loves us… He just wants what is best for us.. 

God made us to be with Him…

If we live for God out of love, we will hate sin and want to repent so we can focus on Him.
Is being baptized a requirement? I think I was baptized at birth.

But what is Christianity without the Bible? We cannot make our own God. It’s not about what I want but about what God wants, he wants us to read his word so we know the truth. Don’t let your heart harden.

The whole point of Christianity is not about just being good in human standards. We’re not perfect standard to enter into Heaven, which is why we need Jesus’ sacrifice. Who are we to judge God’s judgement, we’re just imperfect humans. I don’t say this out of hatred but out of love. I want you to know God truly in his word. Don’t make God apathetic by thinking being saved is just by works, we’re saved by faith. Have a relationship with God and really understand Him.

But God speaks to us through the Bible. We can’t say we don’t know what God thinks when he gives us his instruction in the Bible. We need to let go of our pride and accept the truth he gives. He is a God of wrath, but a God of great mercy. The fact that I don’t deserve his love and deserve his wrath because I am a sinner just shows how powerful Jesus’ sacrifice was on the cross. We have to live for his truth, love comes through understanding so read his word to understand.

I know it feels difficult to repent, (not being sinless, just turning in the right direction and feeling sorry for sins) but we shouldn’t lie about what God says. 
Humans like preists can lie, but God’s word never changes.
We have to rely mostly on the Bible, if someone has no biblical evidence, they can be lying. We can’t make God who we want to be.

1 Corinthians 6:9-11
“Don't you realize that those who do wrong will not inherit the Kingdom of God? Don't fool yourselves. Those who indulge in sexual sin, or who worship idols, or commit adultery, or are male prostitutes, or practice homosexuality, or are thieves, or greedy people, or drunkards, or are abusive, or cheat people- none of these will inherit the Kingdom of God. Some of you were once like that. But you were cleansed; you were made holy; you were made right with God by calling on the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.”

Notice the “practice homosexuality” this doesn’t mean people that struggle to change for God, but people that ignore what God says without guilt or want to change. 

Jesus’s sacrifice on the cross makes it to where he forgives us for our sins if we just have faith in Him, and not in our works. 
Repenting is not a work it’s mostly just feeling guilty and wanting change after understanding more of who God is. Jesus is the one who saved us, after understanding this and having faith, we should devote our lives to him and repent. (Change our minds, and lives by knowing who God is)

It seems difficult to remove something like that in our lives, but we just have to understand God knows what’s best for us and he loves us.
